**What and why**

**Tested on the device?** (kernel `uname -r` and patches, distribution, what you measured or observed, or "not tested on hardware")

- [ ] Every commit has `Signed-off-by:` (DCO, `git commit -s`); see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] No serial numbers, MAC or Bluetooth addresses, disk UUIDs, network names, host or user names, home paths
- [ ] No firmware files, driver binaries or text copied from them
- [ ] New files carry SPDX headers (or a `REUSE.toml` entry) and `reuse lint` passes
- [ ] Documentation updated if behaviour changed; "works" only with a measurement or an observation, and a row in `docs/test-results.md` for a test of the plan
